# Aunt Euphemia & Nell Harcourt

- [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) — Friend of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — housemate and affectionate elder at Tabby's Place · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Nell-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Charming P3](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0003)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> At dusk in Tabby's Place, [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) admires the cozy living room where everyone has gathered. Over the past three weeks, the girls and [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) have settled comfortably into their new home after setting up their household furnishings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) claims [Smudge](../character/smudge.md) as her cat after Cressy's attempt to kill him fails. [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) arrives with her two cats, [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), and reassures the girls that she will not strictly supervise them. After initial skirmishes among the cats, [Smudge](../character/smudge.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) eventually become close companions.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)_

> [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) enters and remarks on the falling snow and the pleasures of simple living, while [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) complains about rising prices. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) then reads a humorous letter aloud from [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), sharing news, anecdotes, and curious questions from back home before the group returns to their evening studies.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVII A Letter from Robin

_Sources: [v3 ch.Robin P0](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0000), [v3 ch.Robin P3](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0003), [v3 ch.Robin P5](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0005), [v3 ch.Robin P6](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0006)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) talk about turning twenty and character growth before [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) joins them in her ball gown. [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) discusses her suitors and potential marriage with them before departing for her dance. Afterward, [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) briefly chat about Cressy's unique personality.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIX An Interlude

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P7](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0007), [v3 ch.Interlude P20](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0020), [v3 ch.Interlude P35](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0035)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) converse in the house before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes out to the garden. There, Hugh joins her and proposes, but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rejects his romantic advances in favor of keeping their friendship, which upsets Hugh. Later in her room, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) weeps over the altered relationship while [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) points out her foolishness.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XX Hugh Speaks

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P0](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0000), [v3 ch.Speaks P16](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0016), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P48](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0048)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) prepares for a [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) reception with [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), who comments on Nell's outfit and discusses her own romance with [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) before mentioning that [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) is infatuated with [Rowena Calder](../character/rowena-calder.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) then leaves Tabby's Place with [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) and arrives at the reception, where she notices Hugh chatting with the striking Rowena.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Rowena

_Sources: [v3 ch.Rowena P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Rowena P6](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0006), [v3 ch.Rowena P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Rowena P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

> At Tabby's Place, the young women prepare for upcoming examinations while discussing their future plans and cooking skills. Later, during an evening walk in the park, [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) reveals to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) has proposed to her and she has accepted, reflecting on her past suitors and her devotion to him. Their conversation turns to Nell's own feelings toward [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P14](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0014), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

> The girls return to Tabby's Place for their final year at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), sharing stories, teasing [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) about her past suitors, and settling back into their routine. Later, on a rainy night, [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) combat their study fatigue by reviewing old, dramatic [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) tales. Re-reading an old piece she wrote at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) feels inspired to take a new step.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Wexcombe Year Opens

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), [v3 ch.Opens P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 ch.Opens P30](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0030), [v3 ch.Opens P44](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0044)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives news that her short story was accepted by a magazine, which she celebrates with her housemates at Tabby's Place. Later, during a walk, [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that his family will visit her, though they unexpectedly arrive a day early on Friday. The visit is full of awkward moments, including cats jumping on Mrs. Lisle and Aline accidentally sitting on Honora's hidden chocolate cake, though Cyril's sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) connects warmly with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P30](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0030)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her friends reflect on their college experiences before taking their final exams and attending [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chooses to wear Hugh's flowers and his gift over Cyril's, but after hearing a rumor about Hugh's engagement to [Rowena Calder](../character/rowena-calder.md), she angrily breaks the gift and refuses to dance with him at the graduation ball.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P35](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0035), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038)_

> As the women pack up Tabby's Place in preparation to leave [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) proposes to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in a pavilion by the shore. Realizing at the last second that she does not truly love him, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) turns him down and breaks off their relationship. She returns to her room and tearfully confesses her decision to [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), who initially scolds her but ultimately offers comfort.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Dawn P0](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0000), [v3 ch.Dawn P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 ch.Dawn P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035)_
